firmwares.description: The 1981 Casio MT-40 inside the FM-1: its six auto-accompaniment rhythms plus a 38-riddim bank from The Riddim Real Book, including ROCK — the preset that became the Sleng Teng riddim (Wayne Smith, 1985, 82 BPM). Four drum lanes, a bass line that transposes with the one-key chord you hold, a FILL button, A/B variation and MPC swing. The keyboard keeps playing Felucca's own engines on top.
